definitions.explanation: Being completely focused on one thing or one person with unwavering dedication. Often used positively, especially about love, passion, or effort.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{一途|いちず}に{彼|かれ}を{愛|あい}している。
{一途|いちず}な{性格|せいかく}で、{一|ひと}つのことに{集中|しゅうちゅう}する。
examples.english: She has a single-minded personality and concentrates on one thing.

examples.japanese: {夢|ゆめ}に{向|む}かって{一途|いちず}に{努力|どりょく}してきた{結果|けっか}、ついに{目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: As a result of working single-mindedly toward his dream, he finally achieved his goal.

notes:
USAGE:
Generally a positive quality, especially in romantic contexts where it means being devoted to one person. Can occasionally carry a nuance of being inflexible or blindly focused.

FORMS:
- {一途|いちず}な + noun (devoted; single-minded)
- {一途|いちず}に + verb (wholeheartedly; single-mindedly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一途|いちず}な{愛|あい} (devoted love)
- {一途|いちず}な{人|ひと} (a devoted person)
- {一途|いちず}に{思|おも}う (to think of someone devotedly)
- {一途|いちず}に{打|う}ち{込|こ}む (to devote oneself single-mindedly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ひたむき: earnest; single-minded — emphasizes putting in effort with dedication, often about work or study
- {一心|いっしん}: single-hearted — more literary, focuses on concentrated mental effort
